I like to encourage people to take their time finding a frame that they love. Opticians are inherently sales people but I really dislike when optical establishments want their opticians and sales associates to use high pressure sales tactics.

Saying "you don't have to buy anything right now, if you need to look around that's fine, if you want to come back with someone to give opinions when you have more time also fine" ends up bringing more people back to your shop.
